name: Rajasthan
highCourt: Rajasthan High Court (Principal Seat Jodhpur, Bench Jaipur)
summary: India's largest state by geographic area (10.4% of country). Home to the Thar Desert, Aravalli Range (world's oldest fold mountains), Hill Forts of Rajasthan (UNESCO), and rich Rajput history.
dance: Ghoomar, Kalbelia (UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage), Bhavai, Chari
festivals: Pushkar Camel Fair, Desert Festival (Jaisalmer), Gangaur, Teej
rivers: Chambal, Banas, Luni (inland drainage), Sabarmati, Mahi
minerals: Zinc & Lead (Zawar - sole producer in India), Marble (Makrana), Copper (Khetri)
monuments: Hill Forts (Chittorgarh, Kumbhalgarh, Ranthambore, Amber, Jaisalmer, Gagron), Hawa Mahal, Jantar Mantar, Mehrangarh Fort
nationalParks: Ranthambore, Sariska, Keoladeo Ghana (Bharatpur Bird Sanctuary, UNESCO), Desert National Park, Mukundra Hills
schemes: Mukhyamantri Nishulk Dawa Yojana, Bhamashah / Jan Aadhaar, Chiranjeevi Health Insurance

mcqs.q: Which traditional folk dance of the snake-charmer community in Rajasthan was inscribed on UNESCO's Representative List of Intangible Cultural Heritage in 2010?
mcqs.exp: Kalbelia dance features sensuous, swirling movements replicating serpents, performed to the music of the Pungi and Dafla.

mcqs.q: The wall of which fort in Rajasthan is the second-longest continuous wall in the world after the Great Wall of China (36 km)?
mcqs.exp: Kumbhalgarh Fort, built by Rana Kumbha in the Rajsamand district, features massive perimeter fortifications stretching 36 km.

mcqs.q: Who founded the Mewar Kingdom?
mcqs.exp: Bappa Rawal established the Mewar kingdom in 734 AD after defeating the Mauryas of Chittor.

mcqs.q: Which Rajput ruler is known for his unmatched valor and fought against Akbar's forces in the Battle of Haldighati?
mcqs.exp: Maharana Pratap led the Mewar army in the Battle of Haldighati on 18 June 1576 against the Mughal army led by Man Singh I.

mcqs.q: Who is the author of the epic historical poem 'Prithviraj Raso'?
mcqs.exp: Prithviraj Raso, chronicling the life of Prithviraj Chauhan, was composed in Brajbhasha/Pingal by court poet Chand Bardai.

mcqs.q: Which is the highest peak in Rajasthan and the Aravalli mountain range?
mcqs.exp: Guru Shikhar in Mount Abu (Sirohi district) is the highest peak of Rajasthan with an elevation of 1,722 meters.

mcqs.q: Which river is known as the only perennial river originating within Rajasthan, and has Bisalpur Dam constructed on it?
mcqs.exp: Banas River (Van ki Asha) originates from the Khamnore hills in Rajsamand; Bisalpur Dam in Tonk is built on it.

mcqs.q: Which bird is designated as the State Bird of Rajasthan?
mcqs.exp: The Great Indian Bustard (Ardeotis nigriceps), locally known as Godawan, was declared Rajasthan's state bird in 1981.

mcqs.q: Which animal is recognized as the State Animal of Rajasthan?
mcqs.exp: Chinkara is the state animal (wild category) and Camel was declared the state animal (domestic/heritage category) in 2014.

mcqs.q: Which salt lake in Rajasthan is the largest inland saltwater lake in India?
mcqs.exp: Sambhar Salt Lake situated near Jaipur produces a significant share of India's inland salt.

mcqs.q: The massive perimeter wall of which fort in Rajasthan is the second-longest in the world (36 km)?
mcqs.exp: Kumbhalgarh Fort in Rajsamand, built by Rana Kumbha, features a 36-km long continuous protective stone wall.

mcqs.q: Who was the first Chief Minister of Rajasthan upon its formation?
mcqs.exp: Pandit Heeralal Shastri served as the first Chief Minister of Rajasthan from 7 April 1949 to 5 January 1951.

mcqs.q: Which city in Rajasthan is popularly known as the 'City of Lakes' and 'Venice of the East'?
mcqs.exp: Udaipur, founded by Maharana Udai Singh II, is famous worldwide as the City of Lakes (Pichola, Fateh Sagar).

mcqs.q: Which mineral mine in Zawar (near Udaipur) is India's primary and oldest source of Zinc and Lead?
mcqs.exp: Zawar mines in Udaipur are the sole and historic lead-zinc ore mining district in India.

mcqs.q: Which traditional dance of Rajasthan, performed with brass pots balanced on the head, is renowned worldwide?
mcqs.exp: Chari dance is a popular folk dance originating from the Gujjar community of Kishangarh, balancing flaming brass pots.

mcqs.q: Which district in Rajasthan hosts the famous Pushkar International Camel Fair every year?
mcqs.exp: The historic Pushkar Fair takes place on Kartik Purnima near the sacred Pushkar Lake in Ajmer district.

mcqs.q: Which fort in Rajasthan is perched on the Chitranga hill and is the largest fort in India?
mcqs.exp: Chittorgarh Fort is the grandest hill fort in India, standing as a monument to Rajput chivalry and Jauhar.

mcqs.q: The famous 'Bani Thani' miniature painting of Kishangarh school was painted by:
mcqs.exp: Nihal Chand painted Bani Thani under the patronage of Raja Sawant Singh (Nagari Das) of Kishangarh.

mcqs.q: Which temple dedicated to Jeen Mata is situated in the Aravalli hills of Rajasthan?
mcqs.exp: The sacred temple of Jeen Mata is situated in Rewasa, Sikar district.

mcqs.q: Which place in Rajasthan is renowned for its tyre and tube manufacturing industry?
mcqs.exp: JK Tyre plant is located at Kankroli in Rajsamand district.

mcqs.q: The famous folk deity 'Veer Tejaji' passed away at which holy site in Ajmer district?
mcqs.exp: Sursura in Kishangarh (Ajmer) is where Veer Tejaji attained martyrdom protecting cows.

mcqs.q: Rajasthan is often termed the 'Museum of Minerals' because:
o: It possesses a vast diversity of metallic and non-metallic minerals
mcqs.exp: Rajasthan possesses over 79 varieties of minerals, ranking first in zinc, lead, wollastonite, gypsum, and marble.

mcqs.q: Who founded the Mewar kingdom in 734 AD after defeating the Mauryas of Chittor?
mcqs.exp: Bappa Rawal (Kalbhoj) established the Mewar dynasty at Nagda/Chittorgarh.

mcqs.q: The Battle of Haldighati in 1576 was fought between Maharana Pratap and the Mughal army commanded by:
mcqs.exp: Akbar's general Raja Man Singh I of Amber commanded the Mughal forces at Haldighati on 18 June 1576.

mcqs.q: Who is the author of 'Prithviraj Raso', celebrating the life of Prithviraj Chauhan III?
mcqs.exp: Chand Bardai was the court poet and friend of Prithviraj Chauhan III.

mcqs.q: Which is the highest peak in Rajasthan, situated in the Mount Abu region?
mcqs.exp: Guru Shikhar in Sirohi district rises to an altitude of 1,722 meters (world's oldest fold mountains - Aravalli).

mcqs.q: Which river originating in the Khamnore Hills (Rajsamand) is completely contained within Rajasthan?
mcqs.exp: Banas (Hope of the Forest / Van ki Asha) flows entirely within Rajasthan; Bisalpur Dam in Tonk is on it.

mcqs.q: Which inland saltwater lake in Rajasthan is the largest inland salt lake in India?
mcqs.exp: Sambhar Salt Lake produces roughly 9% of India's total salt and is a designated Ramsar wetland.

mcqs.q: The 36-km long continuous protective perimeter wall of which fort is known as the Great Wall of India?
mcqs.exp: Kumbhalgarh Fort in Rajsamand, built by Rana Kumbha, features the second-longest continuous wall in the world.

mcqs.q: Taragarh Fort (Star Fort), commanding the historic city of Ajmer, was built on which hill?
mcqs.exp: Taragarh Fort was built by Ajaypal Chauhan on Garh Beetli hill, earning it the name Garh Beetli.

mcqs.q: The world-renowned miniature painting 'Bani Thani' belongs to which school of Rajasthani painting?
mcqs.exp: Bani Thani, known as the 'Mona Lisa of India', was painted by Nihal Chand in Kishangarh.

mcqs.q: Which folk dance of the Shekhawati region is performed with sticks during Holi?
mcqs.exp: Gindar dance is an energetic folk dance performed exclusively by men in the Shekhawati region during Holi.

mcqs.q: Who was the first Chief Minister of Rajasthan?
mcqs.exp: Pandit Heeralal Shastri assumed office as the first Premier/Chief Minister of Rajasthan on 7 April 1949.

mcqs.q: The Great Indian Bustard, locally called 'Godawan', was declared the State Bird of Rajasthan in which year?
mcqs.exp: Godawan (Ardeotis nigriceps) was declared the State Bird of Rajasthan in 1981.

mcqs.q: Which mineral mine in Zawar (Udaipur district) is the sole and primary producer of Zinc and Lead in India?
mcqs.exp: Zawar mines in Udaipur are India's oldest and major lead-zinc deposits, operated by Hindustan Zinc.

mcqs.q: Which district in Rajasthan is the leading producer of Isabgol (Psyllium husk)?
mcqs.exp: Jalore district accounts for the largest production of export-grade Isabgol in Rajasthan.

subtopics.name: Geography
subtopics.summary: Location, borders, physical terrain, and major river systems of Rajasthan.

facts.title: Capital & Geographic Scope
facts.content: The capital is Jaipur (Pink City). Rajasthan covers a geographic area of 342,239 sq km across 50 administrative districts.

facts.title: Major Rivers & Drainage Systems
facts.content: Key river systems flowing through the region include: Chambal, Banas, Luni (inland drainage), Sabarmati, Mahi.

facts.title: Geographical Landscape & Highlights
facts.content: India's largest state by geographic area (10.4% of country). Home to the Thar Desert, Aravalli Range (world's oldest fold mountains), Hill Forts of Rajasthan (UNESCO), and rich Rajput history.

practiceQuestions.questionText: Which is the highest peak in Rajasthan and the Aravalli mountain range?
practiceQuestions.questionTextHi: राजस्थान और अरावली पर्वतमाला की सर्वोच्च पर्वत चोटी कौन सी है?
practiceQuestions.explanation: Guru Shikhar in Mount Abu (Sirohi district) is the highest peak of Rajasthan with an elevation of 1,722 meters.
practiceQuestions.explanationHi: माउंट आबू (सिरोही जिला) में स्थित गुरु शिखर 1,722 मीटर की ऊंचाई के साथ राजस्थान और अरावली की सबसे ऊंची चोटी है।

practiceQuestions.questionText: Which river is known as the only perennial river originating within Rajasthan, and has Bisalpur Dam constructed on it?
practiceQuestions.questionTextHi: राजस्थान से पूर्णतः प्रवाहित होने वाली और जिस पर बीसलपुर बांध निर्मित है, वह प्रमुख नदी कौन सी है?
practiceQuestions.explanation: Banas River (Van ki Asha) originates from the Khamnore hills in Rajsamand; Bisalpur Dam in Tonk is built on it.
practiceQuestions.explanationHi: बनास नदी (वन की आशा) राजसमंद के खमनोर की पहाड़ियों से निकलती है और टोंक में बीसलपुर बांध इसी पर बना है।

practiceQuestions.questionText: Which salt lake in Rajasthan is the largest inland saltwater lake in India?
practiceQuestions.questionTextHi: राजस्थान की कौन सी झील भारत की सबसे बड़ी अंतःस्थलीय खारे पानी की झील है?
practiceQuestions.explanation: Sambhar Salt Lake situated near Jaipur produces a significant share of India's inland salt.
practiceQuestions.explanationHi: जयपुर के निकट स्थित सांभर झील भारत की सबसे बड़ी अंतःस्थलीय खारे पानी की झील है।

practiceQuestions.questionText: Which city in Rajasthan is popularly known as the 'City of Lakes' and 'Venice of the East'?
practiceQuestions.questionTextHi: राजस्थान के किस शहर को 'झीलों की नगरी' (City of Lakes) कहा जाता है?
practiceQuestions.explanation: Udaipur, founded by Maharana Udai Singh II, is famous worldwide as the City of Lakes (Pichola, Fateh Sagar).
practiceQuestions.explanationHi: महाराणा उदयसिंह द्वारा स्थापित उदयपुर अपनी सुंदर झीलों (पिछोला, फतेहसागर) के कारण झीलों की नगरी कहलाता है।

practiceQuestions.questionText: Which is the highest peak in Rajasthan, situated in the Mount Abu region?
practiceQuestions.questionTextHi: माउंट आबू क्षेत्र में स्थित राजस्थान की सर्वोच्च पर्वत चोटी कौन सी है?
practiceQuestions.explanation: Guru Shikhar in Sirohi district rises to an altitude of 1,722 meters (world's oldest fold mountains - Aravalli).
practiceQuestions.explanationHi: सिरोही जिले में स्थित गुरु शिखर 1,722 मीटर ऊंचाई के साथ राजस्थान और अरावली पर्वतमाला का सबसे ऊंचा शिखर है।

practiceQuestions.questionText: Which river originating in the Khamnore Hills (Rajsamand) is completely contained within Rajasthan?
practiceQuestions.questionTextHi: राजसमंद की खमनोर की पहाड़ियों से निकलने वाली कौन सी नदी पूर्णतः राजस्थान में बहती है?
practiceQuestions.explanation: Banas (Hope of the Forest / Van ki Asha) flows entirely within Rajasthan; Bisalpur Dam in Tonk is on it.
practiceQuestions.explanationHi: बनास नदी (वन की आशा) पूर्णतः राजस्थान में बहने वाली सबसे लंबी नदी है, जिस पर टोंक में बीसलपुर बांध बना है।

practiceQuestions.questionText: Which inland saltwater lake in Rajasthan is the largest inland salt lake in India?
practiceQuestions.questionTextHi: राजस्थान में स्थित भारत की सबसे बड़ी अंतःस्थलीय खारे पानी की झील कौन सी है?
practiceQuestions.explanation: Sambhar Salt Lake produces roughly 9% of India's total salt and is a designated Ramsar wetland.
practiceQuestions.explanationHi: जयपुर के पास स्थित सांभर झील भारत के कुल नमक उत्पादन का लगभग 9% हिस्सा प्रदान करती है और रामसर साइट है।

subtopics.name: History & Culture
subtopics.summary: Historical formation, classical/folk dances, and vibrant festivals of Rajasthan.

facts.title: State Formation & Language
facts.content: Rajasthan was formally instituted on 30 March 1949. Official language(s): Hindi.

facts.title: Dance Forms & Traditional Arts
facts.content: Celebrated traditional and folk dance forms: Ghoomar, Kalbelia (UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage), Bhavai, Chari.

facts.title: Major Festivals & Celebrations
facts.content: Prominent cultural festivals: Pushkar Camel Fair, Desert Festival (Jaisalmer), Gangaur, Teej.

practiceQuestions.questionText: Who founded the Mewar Kingdom?
practiceQuestions.questionTextHi: मेवाड़ राजवंश की स्थापना किसने की थी?
practiceQuestions.explanation: Bappa Rawal established the Mewar kingdom in 734 AD after defeating the Mauryas of Chittor.
practiceQuestions.explanationHi: बप्पा रावल ने 734 ईस्वी में चित्तौड़ के मौर्य शासक मान मोरी को पराजित कर मेवाड़ राज्य की नींव रखी थी।

practiceQuestions.questionTextHi: हल्दीघाटी के ऐतिहासिक युद्ध में मुगलों के विरुद्ध अदम्य शौर्य का प्रदर्शन करने वाले राजपूत शासक कौन थे?
practiceQuestions.explanation: Maharana Pratap led the Mewar army in the Battle of Haldighati on 18 June 1576 against the Mughal army led by Man Singh I.

practiceQuestions.explanation: Prithviraj Raso, chronicling the life of Prithviraj Chauhan, was composed in Brajbhasha/Pingal by court poet Chand Bardai.

practiceQuestions.questionText: Which traditional dance of Rajasthan, performed with brass pots balanced on the head, is renowned worldwide?
practiceQuestions.questionTextHi: सिर पर पीतल के मटके रखकर नृत्य करने वाला राजस्थान का कौन सा प्रसिद्ध लोकनृत्य है?

practiceQuestions.questionText: Which district in Rajasthan hosts the famous Pushkar International Camel Fair every year?
practiceQuestions.questionTextHi: राजस्थान के किस जिले में विश्व प्रसिद्ध पुष्कर ऊंट मेले का आयोजन प्रतिवर्ष किया जाता है?

practiceQuestions.questionText: The famous 'Bani Thani' miniature painting of Kishangarh school was painted by:
practiceQuestions.questionTextHi: किशनगढ़ चित्रशैली की प्रसिद्ध चित्र 'बनी-ठनी' के चित्रकार कौन थे?

practiceQuestions.explanationHi: किशनगढ़ के राजा सावंत सिंह (नागरीदास) के समय चित्रकार निहालचंद ने 'बनी-ठनी' का विश्वप्रसिद्ध चित्र बनाया था।
practiceQuestions.hint: Focus on history culture in Rajasthan.

practiceQuestions.explanation: Sursura in Kishangarh (Ajmer) is where Veer Tejaji attained martyrdom protecting cows.

practiceQuestions.hint: Focus on history culture in Rajasthan.

practiceQuestions.questionText: Who founded the Mewar kingdom in 734 AD after defeating the Mauryas of Chittor?
practiceQuestions.questionTextHi: 734 ईस्वी में चित्तौड़ के मान मोरी को हराकर मेवाड़ राजवंश की स्थापना किसने की थी?
practiceQuestions.explanation: Bappa Rawal (Kalbhoj) established the Mewar dynasty at Nagda/Chittorgarh.
practiceQuestions.explanationHi: बप्पा रावल (कालभोज) ने 734 ईस्वी में मौर्य शासक को हराकर मेवाड़ में गुहिल वंश का गौरव स्थापित किया।

practiceQuestions.questionText: The Battle of Haldighati in 1576 was fought between Maharana Pratap and the Mughal army commanded by:
practiceQuestions.questionTextHi: 1576 में हल्दीघाटी का प्रसिद्ध युद्ध महाराणा प्रताप और किसके नेतृत्व वाली मुगल सेना के बीच हुआ था?
practiceQuestions.explanation: Akbar's general Raja Man Singh I of Amber commanded the Mughal forces at Haldighati on 18 June 1576.
practiceQuestions.explanationHi: अकबर के सेनापति आमेर के राजा मानसिंह प्रथम ने हल्दीघाटी के युद्ध में मुगल सेना का नेतृत्व किया था।

practiceQuestions.questionText: Who is the author of 'Prithviraj Raso', celebrating the life of Prithviraj Chauhan III?
practiceQuestions.questionTextHi: पृथ्वीराज चौहान तृतीय के जीवन पर आधारित महाकाव्य 'पृथ्वीराज रासो' के लेखक कौन हैं?
practiceQuestions.explanation: Chand Bardai was the court poet and friend of Prithviraj Chauhan III.
practiceQuestions.explanationHi: चंद बरदाई पृथ्वीराज चौहान तृतीय के राजकवि और बालसखा थे जिन्होंने पिंगल भाषा में 'पृथ्वीराज रासो' रचा।

practiceQuestions.questionText: The world-renowned miniature painting 'Bani Thani' belongs to which school of Rajasthani painting?
practiceQuestions.questionTextHi: विश्वविख्यात 'बनी-ठनी' चित्र किस राजस्थानी चित्रकला शैली से सम्बन्धित है?
practiceQuestions.explanation: Bani Thani, known as the 'Mona Lisa of India', was painted by Nihal Chand in Kishangarh.
practiceQuestions.explanationHi: चित्रकार निहालचंद द्वारा चित्रित 'बनी-ठनी' किशनगढ़ शैली की उत्कृष्ट कृति है, जिसे भारत की 'मोनालिसा' कहा जाता है।

practiceQuestions.questionText: Which folk dance of the Shekhawati region is performed with sticks during Holi?
practiceQuestions.questionTextHi: होली के अवसर पर शेखावाटी क्षेत्र में पुरुषों द्वारा डंडों के साथ किया जाने वाला प्रमुख नृत्य कौन सा है?
practiceQuestions.explanation: Gindar dance is an energetic folk dance performed exclusively by men in the Shekhawati region during Holi.
practiceQuestions.explanationHi: गींदड़ नृत्य शेखावाटी (सीकर, चूरू, झुंझुनूं) का प्रसिद्ध लोकनृत्य है जो होली के अवसर पर पुरुषों द्वारा किया जाता है।

subtopics.name: Government & Polity
subtopics.summary: Constitutional leadership, administrative structure, and state symbols of Rajasthan.

facts.title: Governor & Constitutional Head
facts.content: The current Governor is Haribhau Bagade.

facts.title: Chief Minister & Administration
facts.content: The Chief Minister of Rajasthan is Bhajan Lal Sharma.

facts.title: High Court Jurisdiction
facts.content: Judicial jurisdiction falls under Rajasthan High Court (Principal Seat Jodhpur, Bench Jaipur).

facts.title: Official State Symbols
facts.content: State Animal: Chinkara & Camel | State Bird: Great Indian bustard (Godavan) | State Flower: Rohida | State Tree: Khejri (Prosopis cineraria).

practiceQuestions.questionText: Which bird is designated as the State Bird of Rajasthan?
practiceQuestions.questionTextHi: राजस्थान का राज्य पक्षी कौन सा है?
practiceQuestions.explanation: The Great Indian Bustard (Ardeotis nigriceps), locally known as Godawan, was declared Rajasthan's state bird in 1981.
practiceQuestions.explanationHi: ग्रेट इंडियन बस्टर्ड को स्थानीय भाषा में गोडावण कहा जाता है, जिसे 1981 में राजस्थान का राज्य पक्षी घोषित किया गया था।
practiceQuestions.hint: Key knowledge regarding Rajasthan polity governance.
practiceQuestions.hintHi: राजस्थान polity governance का महत्वपूर्ण तथ्य।

practiceQuestions.questionText: Which animal is recognized as the State Animal of Rajasthan?
practiceQuestions.questionTextHi: राजस्थान का राज्य पशु किसे घोषित किया गया है?
practiceQuestions.explanation: Chinkara is the state animal (wild category) and Camel was declared the state animal (domestic/heritage category) in 2014.
practiceQuestions.explanationHi: चिंकारा को वन्यजीव श्रेणी तथा ऊंट को 2014 में घरेलू/पशुधन धरोहर श्रेणी में राज्य पशु का दर्जा दिया गया है।
practiceQuestions.hint: Key knowledge regarding Rajasthan polity governance.
practiceQuestions.hintHi: राजस्थान polity governance का महत्वपूर्ण तथ्य।

practiceQuestions.questionText: Who was the first Chief Minister of Rajasthan upon its formation?
practiceQuestions.questionTextHi: राजस्थान के प्रथम मुख्यमंत्री कौन थे?
practiceQuestions.explanation: Pandit Heeralal Shastri served as the first Chief Minister of Rajasthan from 7 April 1949 to 5 January 1951.
practiceQuestions.explanationHi: पंडित हीरालाल शास्त्री 7 अप्रैल 1949 को राजस्थान के प्रथम मुख्यमंत्री बने थे।
practiceQuestions.hint: Key knowledge regarding Rajasthan polity governance.
practiceQuestions.hintHi: राजस्थान polity governance का महत्वपूर्ण तथ्य।

practiceQuestions.questionText: Who was the first Chief Minister of Rajasthan?
practiceQuestions.questionTextHi: राजस्थान के प्रथम मुख्यमंत्री कौन थे?
practiceQuestions.explanation: Pandit Heeralal Shastri assumed office as the first Premier/Chief Minister of Rajasthan on 7 April 1949.
practiceQuestions.explanationHi: पंडित हीरालाल शास्त्री 7 अप्रैल 1949 को राजस्थान के प्रथम मुख्यमंत्री बने थे।

practiceQuestions.questionText: The Great Indian Bustard, locally called 'Godawan', was declared the State Bird of Rajasthan in which year?
practiceQuestions.questionTextHi: ग्रेट इंडियन बस्टर्ड (गोडावण) को किस वर्ष राजस्थान का राज्य पक्षी घोषित किया गया था?
practiceQuestions.explanation: Godawan (Ardeotis nigriceps) was declared the State Bird of Rajasthan in 1981.
practiceQuestions.explanationHi: गोडावण को 1981 में राजस्थान सरकार द्वारा राज्य पक्षी का दर्जा दिया गया था।

subtopics.name: Economy & Agriculture
subtopics.summary: Natural resources, minerals, industrial clusters, and agriculture in Rajasthan.

facts.title: Mineral Wealth & Natural Resources
facts.content: Principal minerals and resources: Zinc & Lead (Zawar - sole producer in India), Marble (Makrana), Copper (Khetri).

facts.title: Economic Profile & Industries
facts.content: Rajasthan plays a vital role in India's economy through key agricultural production, manufacturing corridors, and services.

practiceQuestions.questionText: Which mineral mine in Zawar (near Udaipur) is India's primary and oldest source of Zinc and Lead?
practiceQuestions.questionTextHi: उदयपुर के पास जावर की खानें मुख्य रूप से किस खनिज के उत्पादन के लिए देश भर में प्रसिद्ध हैं?
practiceQuestions.explanation: Zawar mines in Udaipur are the sole and historic lead-zinc ore mining district in India.
practiceQuestions.explanationHi: उदयपुर स्थित जावर की खानें भारत में सीसा और जस्ता के सबसे प्राचीन और प्रमुख स्रोत हैं।
practiceQuestions.hint: Key knowledge regarding Rajasthan economy agriculture.
practiceQuestions.hintHi: राजस्थान economy agriculture का महत्वपूर्ण तथ्य।

practiceQuestions.questionText: Which place in Rajasthan is renowned for its tyre and tube manufacturing industry?
practiceQuestions.questionTextHi: राजस्थान में टायर और ट्यूब बनाने का सबसे बड़ा कारखाना कहाँ स्थित है?
practiceQuestions.explanation: JK Tyre plant is located at Kankroli in Rajsamand district.
practiceQuestions.explanationHi: कांकरोली (राजसमंद) में जेके टायर का प्रसिद्ध कारखाना स्थित है।
practiceQuestions.hint: Focus on economy agriculture in Rajasthan.
practiceQuestions.hintHi: राजस्थान के economy agriculture पर ध्यान दें।

practiceQuestions.questionText: Rajasthan is often termed the 'Museum of Minerals' because:
practiceQuestions.questionTextHi: राजस्थान को 'खनिजों का अजायबघर' क्यों कहा जाता है?
options: It possesses a vast diversity of metallic and non-metallic minerals
optionsHi: यहाँ केवल सोना पाया जाता है
यहाँ धात्विक एवं अधात्विक खनिजों की अत्यधिक विविधता पाई जाती है
सभी खनिजों का आयात होता है
practiceQuestions.explanation: Rajasthan possesses over 79 varieties of minerals, ranking first in zinc, lead, wollastonite, gypsum, and marble.
practiceQuestions.explanationHi: राजस्थान में 79 से अधिक प्रकार के खनिज पाए जाते हैं, जिसके कारण इसे खनिजों का अजायबघर कहा जाता है।
practiceQuestions.hint: Focus on economy agriculture in Rajasthan.
practiceQuestions.hintHi: राजस्थान के economy agriculture पर ध्यान दें।

practiceQuestions.questionText: Which mineral mine in Zawar (Udaipur district) is the sole and primary producer of Zinc and Lead in India?
practiceQuestions.questionTextHi: उदयपुर जिले में स्थित जावर की खानें भारत में मुख्य रूप से किस खनिज के उत्पादन के लिए प्रसिद्ध हैं?
practiceQuestions.explanation: Zawar mines in Udaipur are India's oldest and major lead-zinc deposits, operated by Hindustan Zinc.
practiceQuestions.explanationHi: उदयपुर की जावर खानें भारत की सबसे पुरानी और प्रमुख सीसा-जस्ता खानें हैं।

practiceQuestions.questionText: Which district in Rajasthan is the leading producer of Isabgol (Psyllium husk)?
practiceQuestions.questionTextHi: राजस्थान का कौन सा जिला ईसबगोल (घोड़ा जीरा) का प्रमुख उत्पादक है?
practiceQuestions.explanation: Jalore district accounts for the largest production of export-grade Isabgol in Rajasthan.
practiceQuestions.explanationHi: जालौर जिला राजस्थान में ईसबगोल के उत्पादन में अग्रणी स्थान रखता है।

subtopics.name: Places, Monuments & Tourism
subtopics.summary: Heritage landmarks, national parks, and tourism attractions in Rajasthan.

facts.title: Historic Monuments & Cultural Sites
facts.content: Prominent monuments and heritage landmarks: Hill Forts (Chittorgarh, Kumbhalgarh, Ranthambore, Amber, Jaisalmer, Gagron), Hawa Mahal, Jantar Mantar, Mehrangarh Fort.

facts.title: National Parks & Protected Areas
facts.content: Key protected conservation areas: Ranthambore, Sariska, Keoladeo Ghana (Bharatpur Bird Sanctuary, UNESCO), Desert National Park, Mukundra Hills.

practiceQuestions.questionText: The massive perimeter wall of which fort in Rajasthan is the second-longest in the world (36 km)?
practiceQuestions.questionTextHi: राजस्थान के किस किले की प्राचीर (परकोटा) 36 किमी लंबी है और दुनिया में दूसरी सबसे लंबी मानी जाती है?
practiceQuestions.explanation: Kumbhalgarh Fort in Rajsamand, built by Rana Kumbha, features a 36-km long continuous protective stone wall.
practiceQuestions.explanationHi: राणा कुंभा द्वारा निर्मित कुंभलगढ़ किले (राजसमंद) की दीवार 36 किमी लंबी है, जिसे 'द ग्रेट वॉल ऑफ इंडिया' कहा जाता है।
practiceQuestions.hint: Key knowledge regarding Rajasthan places monuments.
practiceQuestions.hintHi: राजस्थान places monuments का महत्वपूर्ण तथ्य।

practiceQuestions.questionText: Which fort in Rajasthan is perched on the Chitranga hill and is the largest fort in India?
practiceQuestions.questionTextHi: चित्रांगद मौर्य द्वारा निर्मित भारत का सबसे विशाल किला कौन सा है?
practiceQuestions.explanation: Chittorgarh Fort is the grandest hill fort in India, standing as a monument to Rajput chivalry and Jauhar.
practiceQuestions.explanationHi: चित्तौड़गढ़ का किला भारत का सबसे बड़ा दुर्ग है, जिसे 'किलों का सिरमौर' भी कहा जाता है।
practiceQuestions.hint: Key knowledge regarding Rajasthan places monuments.
practiceQuestions.hintHi: राजस्थान places monuments का महत्वपूर्ण तथ्य।

practiceQuestions.questionText: Which temple dedicated to Jeen Mata is situated in the Aravalli hills of Rajasthan?
practiceQuestions.questionTextHi: राजस्थान में जीण माता का प्रसिद्ध मंदिर किस जिले की अरावली पहाड़ियों में स्थित है?
practiceQuestions.explanation: The sacred temple of Jeen Mata is situated in Rewasa, Sikar district.
practiceQuestions.explanationHi: जीण माता का पवित्र मंदिर सीकर जिले के रेवासा गांव के पास स्थित है।
practiceQuestions.hint: Focus on places monuments in Rajasthan.
practiceQuestions.hintHi: राजस्थान के places monuments पर ध्यान दें।

practiceQuestions.questionText: The 36-km long continuous protective perimeter wall of which fort is known as the Great Wall of India?
practiceQuestions.questionTextHi: राजस्थान के किस किले की 36 किमी लंबी दीवार को 'द ग्रेट वॉल ऑफ इंडिया' कहा जाता है?
practiceQuestions.explanation: Kumbhalgarh Fort in Rajsamand, built by Rana Kumbha, features the second-longest continuous wall in the world.
practiceQuestions.explanationHi: राणा कुंभा द्वारा निर्मित कुंभलगढ़ दुर्ग की 36 किमी लंबी प्राचीर दुनिया में चीन की दीवार के बाद दूसरी सबसे लंबी दीवार है।

practiceQuestions.questionText: Taragarh Fort (Star Fort), commanding the historic city of Ajmer, was built on which hill?
practiceQuestions.questionTextHi: अजमेर में स्थित प्रसिद्ध तारागढ़ किला किस पहाड़ी पर बना हुआ है?
practiceQuestions.explanation: Taragarh Fort was built by Ajaypal Chauhan on Garh Beetli hill, earning it the name Garh Beetli.
practiceQuestions.explanationHi: तारागढ़ दुर्ग का निर्माण अजयपाल चौहान ने बीठली पहाड़ी पर कराया था, इसलिए इसे 'गढ़ बीठली' भी कहते हैं।
